headline: Enphase swings to profit on tariff refunds as sales fall
summary_short: Enphase's Q2 2026 revenue fell 19.6% y/y to $291.9M on lower IQ Battery shipments and pricing, but gross margin jumped 13.1ppt to 60.0% on $45.4M of IEEPA tariff refunds, swinging net income to $36.1M ($0.27 diluted EPS) from a $7.4M net loss in Q1 2026.
summary_long: Second-quarter net revenues fell 19.6% y/y to $291.9M on a 40% drop in IQ Battery MWh shipped and lower pricing, partly offset by a 4% rise in microinverter units sold; U.S. revenue fell on the expired Section 25D tax credit, European revenue on soft demand. Gross margin rose 13.1ppt y/y to 60.0%, driven by $45.4M of IEEPA tariff refunds, partly offset by unfavorable fixed-cost absorption on lower battery volumes. GAAP operating income was $51.5M, up 39.2% y/y, swinging from a $29.6M Q1 loss. Net income was $36.1M (diluted EPS $0.27), rebounding from a $7.4M Q1 loss. No forward guidance in this 10-Q. Cash and marketable securities were $937.7M; no share repurchases this quarter.
